definitions: A royal château in Versailles, in the Île-de-France region of France. It was the principal royal residence of France from 1682, under Louis XIV, until the start of the French Revolution in 1789.
A UNESCO World Heritage site and a major tourist attraction, known for its opulent architecture, extensive gardens, and historical significance.
examples: The Palace of Versailles is renowned for its Hall of Mirrors.
Visitors often spend an entire day exploring the Palace of Versailles and its grounds.
Louis XIV commissioned many of the famous features of the Palace of Versailles.
